title: The First Noble Truth is About Happiness
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of this Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of living in harmony with others and cultivating happiness through awareness, openness, and experimentation. Nomon Tim Burnett explores the concept of the Eightfold Path as a way to reduce suffering and achieve freedom from the self, highlighting the interconnectedness of its eight steps and encouraging individuals to focus on one aspect deeply rather than trying to memorize all of them at once. Ultimately, this approach aims to soften our sense of separateness and cultivate compassion, love, and connection with others through warm relationships and Zen practice.
